rules: DESIGN.md defines the complete constraints; this file only supplements information its frontmatter cannot express.
Preserve the existing blue theme and light/dark modes, prioritizing neutral work surfaces.
Primary actions and actual status have fixed color semantics; secondary toolbar actions remain neutral.
dos: Prioritize connection context, SQL, and data.
Reuse semantic tokens and shared components; verify light/dark themes and keyboard access.
donts: Do not introduce a second decorative accent, rainbow toolbars, or a separate AI palette.
Do not describe migration targets as implemented behavior.
